summary: Find each color-1 rectangular frame with one missing non-corner cell on its top or bottom edge. Find the single colored interior dot aligned with that notch. Preserve the frame, fill every zero in its strict interior and the notch with the dot color, and paint exactly one full-frame-width row immediately outside the notched edge. Process frames independently.
